method: Independent Fraction sparse rational polynomial replay of saved selected arrays only; no producer or CAS imports; reused old separate-review field helpers only
adjugate_extension_on_old_nonzero_minor_: selected square block is invertible on its old minor open. Free rows identity forces the unique adjugate kernel; all apparent extra rational-kernel poles extend there. C=0 rational identity therefore holds at every point of that open. Old minor complement hierarchy is retained.
